notes.title: Notice of Spring Festival holiday
notes.notes:
Dear friends,

We are going to take a vacation from January 26 to February 2 since Spring Festival is coming on January 27. In China, Spring Festival is a time for family reunion. Being away from home for a long time, we can hardly wait to meet our family!ːsteamhappyː

If you have any question, idea or suggestion during this time, please leave your message here. We will reply to you soon after the vacation. Please accept our sincere apology for the inconvenience.

All the best wishes to you and loved ones! Be lucky in the Year of Rooster!

Blueberry Studio

notes.title: Werther Quest is Released Today! Thank you!!!
notes.notes:
It's exciting Werther Quest is released today. We are grateful to those who support us all the way.

The idea that never stop longing for family and hopes is what Werther Quest tries to express. Taking it into consideration, we have spent three years in developing the game. There was a sea of troubles and frustrates in the past three years. We were labouring with it, however, we never gave it up.We have spared no effort to do the work until it is released today. Although we have tried our best, it's still not a perfect game. Honestly, we have no regrets for doing best you could is the greatest enjoyment.

Spring Festival is coming soon, which means a lot to Chinese family.I can still remember I didn't go home to reunite with my family at that time three years ago because of some unexpected matters, which made me extremely frustrated. For that reason, an idea suddenly came into my mind that a brave teenager named Werther leaves home to seek for family and hopes. Coincidentally, we finished the first part of the game Make Sail on the eve of Spring Festival after three years. We're happy that we can now pack our luggage and go home to keep our family together. Now I am, starting my journey to family and hopes like Werther. Meanwhile, may you enjoy yourselves in the game!

Last but not least, a thousand sincere thanks to people that help and support us!

Happy New Year!

Blueberry Studio

notes.title: Please Contact us if you want Release Override Keys! Thanks!
notes.notes:
Dear friends,

Happy New Year! Werther Quest is now in the final test for the full version. We would like to express our sincere gratitude to those who have added it to their wishlist. It's your trust and support that makes Werther Quest Greenlit and available on Steam! Thank you all! In return,we have requested some keys from Valve to those who have interest in Werther Quest and require immediate access to the game.Perhaps we will have a review on your request since the number of Release Override keys is samll, but it all depends. Anyway we'll try our best to satisfy your request for immediate access by other means. Now you can directly email your request to us at sylvialiaosl@gmail.com or leave your email address below. We'll send it to you as soon as possible.

To conclude, Werther wish you a joyous New Year and much happiness,my friends! 

Thank you!
Blueberry Studio

notes.title: Werther Quest Is Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Yes! We are coming soon on Steam!!! Thanks a lot for those who voted for Greenlight.

It took us more than three years to develop the game. People always leave home to pursue their dreams alone, however,they will come to realize their longing for family as time flies, of which Werther Quest may remind you.The game is filled with warmth and fragrance like childhood.We wish you could enjoy yourselves in the game and reflect on the happy memories in childhood.

Definitely there are still some bugs in the game, but we will make strenuous efforts to improve it and get approved on Steam. We are looking forward to your feedback on the game. May you have a wonderful time in the game! 

Thank you again!
Blueberry Studio
